meta.privacy: PII-safe presentation payload. Names, accounts, addresses, coordinates and track identifiers are excluded.

dataQuality.notes: The card source is intentionally corrupted and contains many repeated rows. Card records are filtered to positive amounts but are not presented as one person. Spotify is aggregated to listening-day metrics for the UI.

chapters.kicker: A RECEIPT FOR THE WHOLE SELF
chapters.title:
Three datasets.
One very human shape.
chapters.body: Your household choices, card swipes and listening rituals are different kinds of evidence. Together, they make a softer picture of a year.

chapters.title:
The little things
do the talking.
chapters.body: Most of a spending story is made from ordinary categories — the repeatable, easy-to-miss rituals that keep a day moving.

chapters.title:
Some choices
arrive by card.
chapters.body: The card dataset adds another lens: a wider, more varied set of purchases. We keep only category, date and amount — never identity.

chapters.title:
And every day
has a rhythm.
chapters.body: The listening history is not spending at all. It is context: the songs, skips and platforms that give the numbers a little weather.
